mhUrlIntro.message: Checks the page address and the URLs the page requests: scripts, XHR and fetch calls, images, frames and pings.

mhUrlHow1.message: Without Regex, the URL must contain the text, ignoring case. The whole URL counts, query string included.

mhUrlHow2.message: With Regex, leave out the / at both ends and write dots as `\.`, as in `^https://js\.example\.com/`.

mhUrlHow3.message: URL scope: Page checks only the page address, Scripts adds script sources, All (default) adds every request.

mhUrlLimit1.message: Font, media and stylesheet requests are not recorded.

mhUrlLimit2.message: Only requests made before the scan count; the scan runs once the page has loaded.

mhHeaderIntro.message: Checks the headers of the page's own request and response, not those of scripts, XHR calls or frames.

mhHeaderHow1.message: Header names are compared in lower case, and plain text means “contains”: `server` also matches `server-timing`. For an exact name, use Regex `^server$`.

mhHeaderHow2.message: The value is checked on the header with that name; leave it empty to accept any value.

mhHeaderHow3.message: Response scope (default) means headers the site sent; Request means headers the browser sent.

mhHeaderLimit1.message: With Case sensitive on, write header names in lower case.

mhHeaderLimit2.message: Pages that change address without reloading are scanned again without headers.

mhCookieIntro.message: Checks the page's cookies by name and, optionally, value, HttpOnly and Secure ones included.

mhCookieHow1.message: A plain name matches as a prefix: `_abck` also matches `_abck_2`.

mhCookieHow2.message: `*` stands for any text: `bm_*` matches `bm_sz` and `bm_sv`.

mhCookieHow3.message: For an exact name, turn on Regex and write `^name$`. The value matches when it contains the text.

mhCookieLimit1.message: Request scope (default) reads the browser's cookies for the page; Response reads the cookies the page's response sets.

mhCookieLimit2.message: Cookies of other sites, such as a vendor's frame, are not seen. Long values are cut to 100 characters.

mhContentIntro.message: Searches the page's text: the HTML of its body, its inline scripts and the script and stylesheet files it loads.

mhContentHow1.message: Plain text matches when the text contains it, ignoring case.

mhContentHow2.message: Whole word skips matches inside a longer word; it needs a letter, digit or _ at both ends of the pattern.

mhContentHow3.message: “Only check scripts” searches inline scripts (head included) and JavaScript files only, without HTML or CSS.

mhContentLimit1.message: Files the site does not let other origins read (CORS), or over 5 MB, are skipped.

mhContentLimit2.message: Code inside frames or workers, or loaded after the scan, is not searched.

mhDomIntro.message: Looks for an element in the page body with a CSS selector, once the page has loaded.

mhDomHow1.message: A tag, `.class`, `#id` or `[attribute]`, alone or combined: `.g-recaptcha[data-sitekey]`.

mhDomHow2.message: Attribute tests `=`, `^=`, `$=`, `*=`, `~=` and `|=`; add ` i` before `]` to ignore case.

mhDomHow3.message: Several selectors separated by commas: any of them matches.

mhDomLimit1.message: Not supported, so the rule never matches: spaces or `>` between parts, `:pseudo-classes` and escapes.

mhDomLimit2.message: The head, frames and shadow roots are not searched. The `value` attribute is not read; other attributes are compared on their first 100 characters.

mhWindowIntro.message: Checks a JavaScript global the page defines, such as `grecaptcha.render`.

mhWindowHow2.message: A condition such as `exists`, `typeof function`, `truthy`, `=== true`, `length > 0` or `has keys`. Empty means truthy.

mhWindowHow3.message: A condition detection does not understand never matches, so pick one from the list.

mhWindowLimit1.message: Checked during the first seconds after the page loads; globals created later are missed.

mhWindowLimit2.message: Properties named with a Symbol cannot be written as a path.

mhJsHooksIntro.message: Records when the page calls a browser API, such as `HTMLCanvasElement.prototype.toDataURL`, a sign of fingerprinting.

mhJsHooksHow1.message: The full path to a method or getter: `Navigator.prototype.webdriver`, not `navigator.webdriver`.

mhJsHooksHow2.message: Any call counts; its arguments and result are not checked, so a hook shows that an API was used, not why.

mhJsHooksLimit1.message: Calls count during the first seconds after the page loads (8 seconds at most).

mhJsHooksLimit2.message: Calls in workers or frames are not seen, except built-in targets in same-site frames.

mhPayloadIntro.message: Searches the bodies of the POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE requests the page sends, from any frame.

mhPayloadHow1.message: Plain text matches when the body contains it, ignoring case. Form data is read as `name=value&…`.

mhPayloadHow2.message: The request URL (optional) and the HTTP method limit it to matching requests.

mhPayloadLimit1.message: Only requests sent before the scan count, up to 50 per page.
